disease_entries.subject: Lobar Pneumonia
disease_entries.value: also known as pneumococcal pneumonia, is a lobar distribution of acute lung inflammation caused by bacterial infections such as diplococcus pneumoniae.
disease_entries.symptom: chills, high fever, chest pain, cough, rusty sputum, nausea, vomiting

disease_entries.subject: Pulmonary Actinomycosis
disease_entries.value: pulmonary actinomycosis chronic pyogenic granulomatous disease caused by anaerobic israeli actinomycetes infecting the lungs
disease_entries.symptom: low or irregular fever, cough, cough up a small amount of mucous sputum

disease_entries.subject: Pulmonary Candidiasis
disease_entries.value: pulmonary candidiasis is an acute, subacute, or chronic bronchial and pulmonary infection caused by candida spp
disease_entries.symptom: cough, cough up a small amount of mucous sputum

disease_entries.subject: Single Ventricle
disease_entries.value: single ventricle is a rare congenital malformation.
disease_entries.symptom: cyanosis, tachycardia, slow weight gain

disease_entries.subject: Single Atrium
disease_entries.value: a single atrium is a rare congenital heart disease caused by the absence of the first and second septums of the atrial septum during embryonic development.
disease_entries.symptom: be short of breath and cyanotic when crying

disease_entries.subject: Mitral Insufficiency
disease_entries.value: mitral insufficiency is defined as partial return of blood from the left ventricle to the left atrium during left ventricular contraction due to abnormal anatomy and function of the mitral valve.
disease_entries.symptom: weakness, palpitations, chest pain, exertional dyspnea, orthopnea

disease_entries.subject: Amiba Hepatic Abscess
disease_entries.value: amiba hepatic abscess is caused by histolytic amoeba trophozoites entering the liver via blood flow from intestinal lesions, causing necrosis of the liver.
disease_entries.symptom: long-term fever, right upper abdomen or right lower chest pain, liver swelling tenderness, leukocytosis

disease_entries.subject: Hepatic Fibrosis
disease_entries.value: liver fibrosis is a pathophysiological process, which refers to the abnormal proliferation of connective tissue in the liver caused by various pathogenic factors.
disease_entries.symptom: weakness, loss of appetite, dyspepsia, hepatic hemorrhage, etc.

disease_entries.subject: Hepatic Abscess
disease_entries.value: liver abscess is a suppurative lesion of the liver caused by a variety of microorganisms, such as bacteria, fungi or histolytic amoeba protozoa.
disease_entries.symptom: high fever, liver pain, chills, fatigue

disease_entries.subject: Splenic Rupture
disease_entries.value: the spleen is a substantial organ with abundant blood supply and brittle substance, which is easily ruptured by traumatic violence and causes internal hemorrhage.
disease_entries.symptom: left upper abdominal pain, worsened by deep breathing

disease_entries.subject: Gastric Cancer
disease_entries.value: gastric cancer is a malignant tumor originating from gastric mucosal epithelium
disease_entries.symptom: upper abdominal pain, loss of appetite, emaciation

disease_entries.subject: Gastrocardiac Syndrome
disease_entries.value: refers to functional disorders of the cardiovascular system caused by reflexive gastric disease.
disease_entries.symptom: precordial discomfort or dull pain, or angina, chest tightness and shortness of breath

disease_entries.subject: Polycystic Kidney
disease_entries.value: polycystic kidneys are numerous cysts of varying sizes in the renal parenchyma, which enlarge the whole renal volume.
disease_entries.symptom: kidney enlargement, renal pain, hematuria, hypertension

disease_entries.subject: Renal Injury
disease_entries.value: kidney injury is mostly caused by firearm injury, stabbing injury and local direct or indirect violence.
disease_entries.symptom: shock, urinary extravasation

disease_entries.subject: Renal Cyst
disease_entries.value: cystic lesions in the kidney that are not related to the outside world
disease_entries.symptom: intermittent dull pain in the waist, abdomen and back

disease_entries.subject: Alzheimer Disease
disease_entries.value: alzheimer's disease is dementia caused by chronic progressive central nervous system degeneration
disease_entries.symptom: decreased cognitive function, behavioral disorders, and ability to live gradually

disease_entries.subject: Transient Ischemic Attack
disease_entries.value: transient ischemic attack (tia) is a transient disorder of brain function caused by insufficient blood supply in a region.
disease_entries.symptom: transient aphasia, paralysis, sensory disturbance

disease_entries.subject: Cerebral Hemorrhage
disease_entries.value: it refers to spontaneous hemorrhage in non-traumatic brain parenchyma with various causes, most of which are caused by vascular rupture of hypertensive arteriolosclerosis.
disease_entries.symptom: coma, partial loss of speech function, brain death, sensory impairment

disease_entries.subject: Congestive Splenomegaly
disease_entries.value: congestive splenomegaly is an inflammation or thrombosis of the portal hypertension, portal vein or splenic vein caused by cirrhosis of the liver.
disease_entries.symptom: splenomegaly, ascites, portal hypertension

disease_entries.subject: Ankylosing Spondylitis
disease_entries.value: ankylosing spondylitis is a chronic progressive inflammatory disease that mainly invades the spine and can involve sacroiliac and peripheral joints to varying degrees.
disease_entries.symptom: lumbosacral lesions are particularly prominent in the spine

disease_entries.subject: Spina Bifida
disease_entries.value: a common congenital malformation of spina bifida.
disease_entries.symptom: spinal canal defect, cyst
